provides.description: Curated feed scored on 7 signals. Sprint 85/86 ADR-066: view=home returns the UnifiedFeedItem union ({ items }) of decisions+requests; view=community returns the community-scoped union of requests+activity+story texture (no decisions), requires community_id (400) + caller membership (403), assembled from request-service's own DB reads (no feed-service call), texture best-effort. Action altitude bands: decisions>=2000 > requests 1000-1100 > activity 500 > story 100. Each request item carries payload_type (ADR-067, from category via categoryToPayloadType). view absent keeps the legacy request-array shape. Prior-interaction signal reads the decayed trust_edges_live.current_weight. Sprint 88: minScore defaults to 30, explicit minScore=0 is valid for show-more/all-open expansion, and request impressions are logged for legacy and union request items.

Sprint 89 / ADR-068: the community's weekly help-loop pulse for the warm community Home hero (helpedThisWeek, openAsks, timeSensitive, recentJoins, recentHelpers, windowDays:7). Reuses the exact S86 texture aggregation (shared fetchCommunityPulse helper that also builds the in-feed activity card, so the two never diverge) + one new timeSensitive count. openAsks/timeSensitive count only status=open AND expired=FALSE. Members-only: gated on the JWT communities claim (not communityMemberships) -> 403 for non-members; unknown community -> 404. Read-only, no schema change.
